people.name: Joel M. Galloway
people.bio: Manages the USGS Cooperative Matching Funds program and serves as tribal relations advisor to the Water Mission Area. About 30 years with USGS across Water Science Centers in the Dakotas, Arkansas, Iowa and Wyoming; long-time instructor in field water-quality methods. M.S. civil engineering (South Dakota Mines), B.S. geology (University of North Dakota).
people.research_interests: lake and reservoir processes and modeling; emerging contaminants; water-quality assessment; sediment dynamics

people.name: William Werkheiser
people.bio: Associate Director for the USGS Water Resources Mission Area. Earlier served as USGS Deputy Director (exercising the Director's delegated authority 2017-2018) and later as Interior's Senior Science Advisor and Scientific Integrity Officer. Received a Presidential Rank Award (Distinguished Executive, 2016). M.S., University of Massachusetts; B.S., Bloomsburg University.

people.name: Joshua Joseph, Jr.
people.bio: Deputy Associate Director of the USGS Water Resources Mission Area, coordinating science across the mission area and with interagency programs. Brings 25+ years in environmental and water-resources science, engineering and policy, with prior roles at Bechtel National, Procter & Gamble and the US EPA.

people.name: Timothy D. Oden
people.bio: Director of the USGS New Jersey Water Science Center. Previously led the Water Mission Area's Field Support Team in the Hydrologic Networks Branch and coordinated the water-quality partnership between USGS and the National Park Service; earlier was hydrologic data chief at the Pennsylvania center and a water-quality specialist in Texas and the Central Region.
people.research_interests: water-quality field methods; PFAS sampling methods; continuous water-quality sensors; national stream temperature network

people.name: Heidi L. Hoppe
people.bio: Associate Director and supervisory hydrologist at the USGS New Jersey Water Science Center, leading its science quality branch and statewide hydrologic data collection (surface water, tide, groundwater, water quality). With the center since 1999, she has been data chief and led the state's tide-gauge network and flood-warning systems.
people.research_interests: surface- and groundwater quality; streamflow; groundwater monitoring; trace-element contamination; aquatic ecosystems
